answer: An hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The lotus schedule is applied in ferrous and terrace makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2370 identities would post 764 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
